name: Sorge Flack
source: The name of Mortimarch Sorge is known to every citizen of Kudesh. It is said that she is the oldest symbiote in the sector, if not in the entire city. Strict and laconic, she spends most of her time in laboratories, working for the benefit of society and science. Thanks to her, Seventh sector performs unique grafting surgeries.
